svg.title: ELECHOUSE PN532 V3: choose the host mode
svg.desc: V3 manual revision B, 2013-11-05. Switch settings are not transferable to V4, MINI, USB or unbranded boards.

g.text: One module, one selected host interface
Change switches with power removed; use the original V3 board view for switch numbering.
Use the corresponding UART, I2C or SPI guide plus the original V3 header drawing. Antenna/card
V3 manual revision B, 2013-11-05. Switch settings are not transferable to V4, MINI, USB or unbranded
